claims.excerpt: ## Why Estimates of the 1906 Earthquake’s Magnitude Differ
claims.label: F0
claims.sourceEvidence: The synthesis says, “Different methods of estimating earthquake size can disagree.”
claims.synthesisStatement: Different methods can produce different earthquake-size estimates.
claims.narrativeStatement: The selected story is “Why the 1906 earthquake has different magnitude estimates.”
claims.explanation: The headline accurately frames the supported contrast.

claims.excerpt: One team examined seismic recordings from 96 observatories, then digitized and modeled usable data from 12.
claims.label: F0
claims.sourceEvidence: The source verification states that seismic waves were recorded at 96 observatories and 12 stations had records suitable for digitization and modeling.
claims.synthesisStatement: One team studied recordings from 96 observatories and digitized and modeled usable data from 12.
claims.narrativeStatement: The context step gives the same 96-observatory and 12-data-source scope.
claims.explanation: Faithfully preserves the counts and the usable-data qualification; “then” does not materially change the account.
